SEC-01.title: Ed25519 Request Proof-of-Possession
SEC-01.description: All paired companion and remote HTTP requests must include Ed25519 cryptographic signatures over canonical method, path, timestamp, and nonce headers.
SEC-01.failure_mode: Unauthorized request replay, forged mobile companion actions, or impersonation.

SEC-02.title: In-Memory Credential Isolation & No SessionStorage
SEC-02.description: Master encryption keys and provider credentials must remain strictly in-memory or secure hardware vaults, never persisted to localStorage or sessionStorage.
SEC-02.failure_mode: Cleartext credential harvesting by third-party browser scripts or cross-origin sniffing.

SEC-03.title: Strict Production Origin Whitelist (Fail-Closed)
SEC-03.description: WebSocket connections in production environments must enforce explicit ALLOWED_ORIGINS whitelist, failing closed on missing or unexpected Origin headers.
SEC-03.failure_mode: Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking (CSWSH) and unauthorized browser session bridging.

SEC-04.title: CAS Restoration Workspace Boundary Enforcement
SEC-04.description: Content Addressable Storage (CAS) file restoration and history retrieval must validate all target paths against the authorized workspace root using validate_path.
SEC-04.failure_mode: Arbitrary file overwrite or system file corruption via path traversal.

SEC-05.title: MCP Tool Binary Whitelist & Shell Injection Prevention
SEC-05.description: MCP server definitions and shell commands from templates must be scanned against binary whitelists and passed as direct argument slices to prevent subshell spawning.
SEC-05.failure_mode: Remote code execution or subshell injection via untrusted template installs.

SEC-06.title: Mandatory Security Floor Clamps & HITL Oversight
SEC-06.description: Autonomous agents cannot execute tools beyond their signed capability manifest. High-risk actions require non-bypassable Human-in-the-Loop approval gates.
SEC-06.failure_mode: Privilege escalation, unauthorized system configuration changes, or rogue tool invocation.

SEC-07.title: Authenticated Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Communication
SEC-07.description: Inter-agent messages and mailbox dispatches must authenticate sender identities, bound task delegation depths, and sanitize shared RAG context to prevent swarm hijacking.
SEC-07.failure_mode: Swarm lateral movement, header spoofing, or memory poisoning.

SEC-08.title: Budget Guard Financial & Resource Quota Metering
SEC-08.description: All LLM inference, multimodal live voice streaming, and tool execution must enforce pre-flight balance checks and real-time quota debiting to prevent resource exhaustion.
SEC-08.failure_mode: Financial denial-of-wallet, unbounded API token consumption, or server memory exhaustion.
